# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow the repository-wide rules in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). Use [docs/README.md](../docs/README.md) to find the requirements for the change: the [Platform FRD](../docs/requirements/frd/PLATFORM-FRD.md) for shared platform behavior and the [Edu FRD](../docs/requirements/frd/EDU-FRD.md) for Oxinov Edu, and the other product FRDs in [docs/requirements/frd](../docs/requirements/frd/). Cite requirement IDs, keep tenant isolation and PostgreSQL ownership explicit, and never suggest customer passwords or client-side trust checks.
